description: Implements FORMULATION.md section 3a: splits the enriched frame into the 'buildable' subset (bottom 40th percentile of C_i within the run's own candidate set) and a rejection tally.
signature: def apply_simplicity_filter(frame: pd.DataFrame, params: AnalysisParams) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, dict[str, int]]
docstring:
Split candidates into the simple/buildable subset and the rest.

Args:
    frame: games_enriched-shaped DataFrame for the run (storage.read_enriched output), including rows with NULL complexity_score.
    params: AnalysisParams.simplicity_percentile (locked value: 0.40) -- a percentile cutoff, NOT an absolute complexity score ceiling.

Returns:
    (buildable, rejected_by_reason): buildable contains rows whose complexity_score is non-null AND <= the run-local percentile(frame['complexity_score'].dropna(), params.simplicity_percentile * 100) cutoff. rejected_by_reason has keys 'above_simplicity_threshold' and 'null_complexity_score', counting rows excluded for each. Rows with NULL complexity_score are excluded from `buildable` but this function does not remove them from any other frame the caller holds -- the module's density/competition functions separately re-read the full frame when they need NULL-complexity rows included, per the module's own invariant 'Rows with NULL complexity_score are excluded from the subset but remain available for density counting'.
postconditions: The percentile cutoff is computed fresh from THIS run's own non-null complexity_score distribution every call -- never a value carried over from another run or hard-coded

edge_cases.input: A row with complexity_score exactly at the computed percentile cutoff
edge_cases.expected_behavior: included in buildable (inclusive boundary, <=), per the module's own testing requirement 'honours the threshold at the boundary'

buildable is empty; rejected_by_reason['null_complexity_score'] == len(frame); no percentile can be computed (pandas quantile on an empty non-null series), handled by short-circuiting to an empty buildable frame rather than raising

edge_cases.input: frame has zero rows entirely (empty candidate set)

unit_tests.name: test_boundary_row_included
unit_tests.description: A row exactly at the 40th percentile cutoff is included in buildable.

unit_tests.name: test_null_complexity_rows_excluded_and_tallied
unit_tests.description: Rows with NULL complexity_score are absent from buildable and counted under null_complexity_score.
unit_tests.expected: those rows absent; tally matches count

unit_tests.name: test_all_null_complexity_handled_without_raising
unit_tests.description: An all-NULL complexity_score frame returns an empty buildable set without raising.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_frame
unit_tests.description: Zero input rows returns empty buildable and all-zero tallies.
